grading.signHint: Sign with your finger or a stylus.

grading.readOnlyNote: This form is signed and therefore read-only.

grading.errNoTrainee: Please select a trainee for every pilot.

admin.trendHint: A competency graded low across the fleet points to a systemic training gap.
admin.competencyHint: Competencies and observable behaviours are maintained centrally and apply to all forms of the respective set.
admin.calibrationHint: Deviation from the overall average. Values from ±0.50 are highlighted and indicate systematically harsher or milder grading.
admin.exportHint: Unprocessed raw data for audits, separated by training, competencies and people.
admin.deferredRecipients: Recipients Form 310 (Deferred Item List) — always notified

grading.attendance307B: With the signature, the instructor/examiner confirms the participation of all individuals listed to the full extent and within the specified timeframe of the respective event.
grading.footnote1: * Tick if two or more competencies are graded with 2 or below; refer to Form 306 – Additional Training.
grading.footnote2: ** Tick if one or more required items are not completed; describe not completed items in the comment box and Form 310, Deferred Item List.
grading.footnote3: *** Ready for skill test to be signed on Form 311.
grading.errGradeComment: {{name}}: a comment is mandatory for every competency graded 1 or 2.
grading.errComments: {{name}}: positive aspects, development areas and summary are mandatory.
grading.autoNotCompetent: Automatically Not Competent: one or more competencies graded “1”, or two or more graded “2”.
grading.sessionDataHint: These items are always entered after the grading, at the end of the session.
grading.sigLiveNote: Signatures are never stored or carried over — whenever a signature is required, it must be given live on this device.
grading.retentionHint: Grading sheets remain visible in your view for one week after creation. Admins keep the full record permanently.
grading.deleteOwnConfirm: Remove this grading sheet from your view? It remains stored for admins.
grading.deferredMailNote: Form 310 (Deferred Item List) is always emailed to the Training Admin upon completion: {{recipients}}
